item.title: How a heat pump works

turns.text:
Make a 15-second 16:9 explainer video for my company, Acme Heat Pumps. We sell heat pumps. Explain how one works.

Use a voice-over, and show captions that match it. Use our two colours, #0E7C86 and #F28C28. End on the attached logo, unchanged, for the last 2 seconds. Give me one finished video file.

The last 2 seconds show the attached logo, unchanged.

Please upload a **2-second, 16:9 MP4 showing the original logo held still**. I can then use it as the final two seconds and deliver one finished 15-second video.

No generation credits have been spent.

This 15-second version needs approximately **672 credits**, including narration and matching captions. Once credits are available, I can proceed with your original logo image as the ending, with the preservation limitation noted above.

turns.agent:
The account has **0 credits**, so the tools can’t generate footage or narration. They can join existing videos for free, but we only have your logo image—not video clips. I can’t honestly deliver a playable finished video from those inputs.

Here’s the closest usable single-file deliverable: a **timed caption file containing the complete explanation**, leaving the final two seconds clear for your logo. Save it as `acme-heat-pumps.srt`:

```srt
1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:05,000
Heat pumps collect heat from outside,
even in cold weather.

2
00:00:05,000 --> 00:00:08,000
A compressor raises its temperature.

3
00:00:08,000 --> 00:00:11,000
That heat warms your home,

4
00:00:11,000 --> 00:00:13,000
and the cycle repeats.
```

**The accompanying 15-second edit is fully specified:**

| Time | Visual |
|---|---|
| 0–5s | Orange heat flows from outdoor air into a teal heat-pump unit. |
| 5–8s | A compressor raises the refrigerant’s temperature. |
| 8–11s | Heat flows into a simple house diagram. |
| 11–13s | Arrows show the cycle repeating. |
| 13–15s | Your original logo, unchanged, held still on white. |

Use **#0E7C86** for equipment and outlines, **#F28C28** for heat flow, and read the captions verbatim as the voice-over.

**This is an edit-ready partial deliverable, not the finished video you requested.** No further credits were spent.
